options.name: abortOnPreSyncScriptFailure
options.description: Do not rsync if the pre sync script exited with a non zero exit code

options.name: autoDirtyDelay
options.description: Time to wait before automatically marking an filesystem part as dirty, set 0 to disable

options.name: cloneFrom
options.description: The id or name of the entity that the new entity will be cloned from.  (take effect only at entity creation)

options.name: dirtyAutoSyncDelay
options.description: Time to wait before automatically syncing after the filesystem part became dirty, set 0 to disable

options.name: extraRsyncArguments
options.description: Extra rsync arguments. These can be made condition based on type=no-new-files|normal and mode=sync|update|full|sync. For example: --max-delete=0?type=normal&mode=update|sync

options.name: path
options.description: Full source path of the filesystem part

options.name: postSyncScript
options.description: Script to be executed after rsync runs

options.name: preSyncScript
options.description: Script to be executed before rsync runs

options.name: rsyncAcls
options.description: Rsync with --acls

options.name: rsyncBandWidthLimit
options.description: Rsync with --bwlimit=<value>

options.name: rsyncBlockSize
options.description: Rsync with --block-size=<value> Max 128KB, 0 implies rsync default

options.name: rsyncCompress
options.description: Rsync with --compress

options.name: rsyncCompressLevel
options.description: Rsync compression at a specific level

options.name: rsyncDelta
options.description: Rsync with --inplace --no-whole-file

options.name: rsyncForce
options.description: Rsync with --force

options.name: rsyncHardlinks
options.description: Rsync with --hard-links

options.name: rsyncNumericIds
options.description: Rsync with --numeric-ids

options.name: rsyncPrune
options.description: Rsync with --prune-empty-dirs

options.name: rsyncSparse
options.description: Rsync with --sparse

options.name: rsyncXattrs
options.description: Rsync with --xattrs

options.name: runPostOnFailure
options.description: Run the post rsync script even if the pre sync or sync ended with a non zero exit code

options.name: state
options.description: The state the resource should have

options.name: syncScriptTimeout
options.description: Script timeout

options.name: type
options.description: The type of filesystem part

options.name: watchDirectories
options.description: Watch directories for changes on the active head node, filesystem part will be marked dirty when changed
